last.verdict: Growth slowed to 12% and holiday outlook disappointed, though shares recovered from early lows.

reasons.label: Weak holiday outlook
reasons.text: Q4 revenue guided to $1.425–1.475B (8–12% growth), below the roughly $1.52B analysts expected.

reasons.label: Europe sellers pulled back
reasons.text: After the EU ended a tariff exemption, cross-border sellers cut ads; Europe revenue was flat.

reasons.label: Missed Q3 targets
reasons.text: Revenue of $1.174B (up 12%, from 18% in Q2) missed the $1.19–1.21B guidance.

story: Growth has slowed from 18% in Q2 to 12% in Q3, and the Q3 outlook was missed. Each report has brought a cautious forecast. Shares fell 8.7% last time and 2.8% now, a smaller drop.

history.verdict: Beat on sales and profit, but weaker Q3 outlook sent shares lower.

reasons.label: Slower growth ahead
reasons.text: Q3 revenue guided to $1.19–1.21B, only 13–15% growth versus 18% in Q2.

reasons.label: One-time Q2 boosts
reasons.text: Amazon's Prime Day shifted into Q2 and World Cup ad spending won't repeat in Q3.

reasons.label: Ad competition worries
reasons.text: Investors fretted over rivals Instagram and Reddit, plus weakness in Europe and rising GPU costs.
